selected.primary_estimand: Effect of 8 weeks of endurance exercise training (EET) vs sedentary control on gene expression in rat BAT (F344, 6 months old, 5 M + 5 F per group)
planned_contrasts: 8-week EET vs control, BAT (S2.7.p1, FIG6A); ERGs total 3,477 across 8 tissues; paper: 1237 ERGs
selected.sample_inclusion: 5 animals per sex per group randomly selected for assays (S5.4.2.p1); one female BAT sample excluded (S2.1.p1)
selected.paper_method: DESeq2 LRT per sex: full ~ technical covariates + training group (control,1,2,4,8 w) vs reduced ~ technical covariates; Fisher sum-of-logs across sexes; IHW across tissues; 5% FDR; keep genes whose week-8 log2FC agrees in sign in both sexes (S5.4.3.p2)
selected.low_count_filter: remove genes with CPM <= 0.5 in all but one sample, per tissue (S5.4.3.p1)

paper_threshold.adjustment: IHW (tissue as covariate) on Fisher-combined male/female LRT p-values
paper_threshold.extra_rule: direction of week-8 log2FC must agree between males and females

selected.paper_results: 3,477 ERGs across 8 tissues; BAT 1,237 (largest), hippocampus 124 (smallest); lung ~2x more down than up (S2.7.p1)

decisions.reason: S2.7.p1 and S5.4.3.p2 define ERGs; S5.4.2.p1 sample selection; S5.4.3.p1 filtering. The paper's estimand is EET vs control at 8 weeks, with the LRT including the 1/2/4 w groups.

selected.deviation_note: paper: 5% IHW-FDR on Fisher-combined per-sex LRT p plus sex sign agreement at week 8; applied: BH padj < 0.05 on the pooled Wald W8 vs SED test, no fold-change rule (the paper has none). Sign agreement is computed afterwards in HANDBACK as a supplementary count.

decisions.reason: S5.4.3.p2: ERGs at 5% IHW FDR, no fold-change cutoff.

S5.4.3.p2 tests males and females separately with all training groups in the model; male model ~ grp (25 animals); week-8 contrast feeds the sign-agreement rule.
